```yaml
name: Remove experimental decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  remove-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Set up GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run experimental decorator removal script
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected. Exiting."
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          else
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Configure Git
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Create branch and commit changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        id: create_branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BRANCH="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators"
          git push origin "$BRANCH"
          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          BRANCH=${{ steps.create_branch.outputs.branch }}
          cat <<EOF > /tmp/pr_body.txt
          This PR removes experimental decorators from the codebase.

          Changes:
          $(git diff --name-only)
          EOF
          gh pr create --title "Remove experimental decorators" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --head "$BRANCH" \
            --base main \
            --label automated
```
